title: GENTEQ OEM Replacement Motor, 1/4 HP, 1100 RPM, 208-230V, TEAO

comparisons.notes: Genteq 3905, 1/4 HP, 1100 RPM, 208-230V, 48 frame TEAO, new, listed in stock
Same Genteq 3905 TEAO extended-studs listing title, new

writeup: A new Genteq OEM direct-replacement HVAC motor (1/4 HP, 1100 RPM, 208-230V, totally enclosed air-over with extended studs) for $81.99 at Woot. HVAC supply shops list the same Genteq 3905 motor at $169.06 to $269.95. It needs a 5 MFD/370V capacitor, which isn't included, so check your old motor's specs before buying.
